_note: reference-patterns.md §4의 컷 템플릿 규격. check_cuts.py가 슬롯 길이·높이를 검사하고, image-briefs.md 프롬프트 골격이 레이아웃 서술을 가져온다. 폭 1000 기준. 2026-09-04 라운드 A 해부(자사몰·플랫폼 17페이지)로 P1~P5(근거)·X1~X10(공통 문법) 추가 — 상세는 references/style-packs.md.

K1.name: 브랜드 매니페스토 히어로
K1.layout: solid brand-color background with 2-3 translucent gradient blobs on the lower-left and upper-right diagonals; wordmark centered at 35% height spanning 70% width; one quotation line below; a short vertical hairline; two centered paragraphs at 55% width; no product photo

K2.name: 제품명 히어로(해시태그)
K2.layout: dark-to-brand-color vertical gradient; product name large (70px) at upper-left with 3 outlined pill hashtags beside it and 4 short copy lines below (last line bold); lower 55% is a styled product photo (box plus single unit) lit from upper-left

K3.name: 타겟 페르소나 선언
K3.layout: white background; thin kicker line at upper-left, then a two-line calligraphic headline left-aligned 80px inside the column, two sub lines, four hashtag lines with script # marks, and a persona tag in serif brackets like [33세, 대기업 사원]; lower 45% shows a half-body line illustration of the persona on the right 55% and two product units on the left, with one tan brush-stroke diagonal behind

K4.name: TPO 장면 지그재그 3
K4.layout: white background; round badge plus small title at upper-left; three scenes stacked 300px each, text block (40% width) and faceless line illustration in a rounded mask (50% width) alternating left/right; emphasized words in the scene heads carry a yellow highlighter stroke; only the product is in brand color; one footnote line at the very bottom

K5.name: Check Point 목차 3
K5.layout: tan diagonal gradient; kicker plus a large two-line 'Check Point' head at left; three overlapping white circles (300px) in a row at the bottom, each with a brand-color numeral and two short lines

K6.name: Point N 단락
K6.layout: solid cream or tan background; a 'Point N' badge top-center (only N in brand color), hairline, headline (45px), thin sub (33px), hairline, 2-4 body lines; lower 55% is the visual (styled product photo or line icons); one brand-color script callout of ≤10 characters placed diagonally over the visual

K7.name: 기능성 아이콘 링
K7.layout: cream background; a tan pentagon at center with two product units crossed over it; a round line icon (130px) at each vertex with a brand-color script label; two body lines above; the exact approved functional claim wording as 3 centered lines below

K8.name: 근거 카드
K8.layout: white rounded card (82% width) on cream; headline 28px, two-line grey disclaimer 18px, chart title, a chart area (70% width) in dark brand color vs tan, 2-3 conclusion lines, hairline, then 7 left-aligned lines of subject/design/source at 18px. NEVER generate the chart values — leave the chart area as a blank framed panel to be composited or replaced by HTML

K9.name: 섭취 STEP 3
K9.layout: tan background with a lighter rounded panel (60% width) that has a tab-shaped title at top-center; three STEPs stacked 300px each, a white circle (200px) with a hand illustration alternating left/right/left and three text lines on the opposite side; 'STEP.N' in brand-color italic serif hanging above each circle

K10.name: 추천 대상 2×2
K10.layout: brown-to-orange diagonal gradient; two-line head where the second line sits in a white outlined box; a cross divider splits the lower area into 2×2 cells, each with a white line icon (120px) and two short lines

K11.name: 제품 구성 연출
K11.layout: diagonal gradient brightening to peach; styled product photo of the big box, small box and single unit on the diagonal; three spec labels in serif brackets scattered over the photo; head in a white outlined box at top-center

S1.name: 피처 컷(좌정렬)
S1.layout: headline left-aligned with 140px top margin; an image card (80% width, 16px radius) below; 3-5 body lines; image to text area about 72:28

S2.name: 비교 카드
S2.layout: dark card (24px radius) with 24px padding: title, our product name underlined, 1-2 label/value pairs, then the comparison target name and the same pairs; values in equal size, only the winner in brand color; at most 2 items; the comparison target is our own previous product or the old method, never a competitor

S3.name: 아코디언 3단
S3.layout: one card with three items all expanded: item title, image (80% width × 180), 3 body lines each

S4.name: 서비스·신뢰 카드
S4.layout: card: two-line head at left, a small logo, an underlined link, a flat illustration filling the lower-right 40%

L1.name: 스펙 요약 4불릿
L1.layout: light grey; head 8 characters; four 'label : value' bullet lines

L2.name: 국소 FAQ 4문항
L2.layout: light grey; four rounded Q cards (70px each) prefixed with 'Q' — questions only answer what the previous cut raised

L3.name: 치수·배치 도면
L3.layout: front elevation (55% width) and side/top plan (45%) as clean technical line drawings with dimension lines; three footnote lines at the bottom

L4.name: 리뷰 카드 스트립
L4.layout: star rating plus count, four photo thumbnails, three review cards each with stars, a thumbnail and a single truncated line — ONLY with real reviews supplied in raw-input

C1.name: 보증·환불 컷
C1.layout: light neutral background; a large shield or ribbon badge at center-left with the guarantee period as a big numeral; head and 3-5 lines of the exact refund policy at right; no exaggerated words

C2.name: CTA·오퍼 컷
C2.layout: brand-color background; head, one line of the actual deadline or condition, a pill CTA button with the action+result wording; prices only when the platform allows them inside the image

F1.name: 풀바디 룩북 + 모델 정보
F1.layout: studio plain grey backdrop; full-body model centered (65-75% width), 60px top margin; lower-left three short lines: label 'MODEL', height/weight line, worn size line — no other text. Faceless or back-turned figure when generated; real photography strongly preferred

F2.name: 풀바디 포즈 변형
F2.layout: same backdrop, lighting and model as the anchor lookbook cut; pose turned 30-45 degrees; no text

F3.name: 하프바디 근접
F3.layout: knee-up framing, garment fills 60%+ of frame, hardware and drape visible; no text

F4.name: 백뷰
F4.layout: back view of the same outfit, hood down; no text

F5.name: STYLE INFO 코디 표
F5.layout: white; left 80px grid; head 'STYLE INFO' then three rows 'label | product name [color]' — TEXT-ONLY CUT: render as HTML/vector, never generate as image

F6.name: DETAIL 포인트 컷
F6.layout: white canvas; optional 'DETAIL' header 44px on the first one; product-only close-up photo 800×960 at x80; below it 'POINT 0N' 34px bold and 1-2 bullet lines 26px; left-aligned, bold is the only emphasis

F7.name: 반품·교환 정책 카드
F7.layout: light grey (#EFEFEF) card, left 58px; title 54px, lead 2 lines, Q/A pairs with round icons, numbered ①~④ exclusion conditions, contact line — TEXT-ONLY: HTML or platform's official image, never generated

F8.name: 사이즈 실측표
F8.layout: table: size × 총장·어깨·가슴·소매 in cm with a ±tolerance line — MEASUREMENTS MUST NEVER BE GENERATED: HTML table only (legal.md)

P1.name: 근거 히어로(통계·판매량 리드)
P1.layout: centered oversized statistic or ranking line as the headline (numbers only from input), 3-4 satisfaction/percentage bars or badges below, product small at the bottom edge; neutral or brand-dark background

P2.name: 인증·수상 배지 그리드
P2.layout: 2-column grid of 4-8 cards, each an official mark or award icon plus a 2-line caption; one bold head above; light background

P3.name: 대조군 계측 카드(A/B 비교)
P3.layout: two equal panels side by side labelled inside the image (conventional vs ours), same framing and lighting, measured object (scale, UV light, gauge) visible; footnote line with test condition at the bottom

P4.name: Before/After 2분할 카드
P4.layout: left grey Before panel and right brand-color After panel with one large percentage badge; grey footnote strip for institution, period, sample size

P5.name: 리뷰 그리드(사진+핵심문장)
P5.layout: large average rating numeral on top, then 3-5 review cards each with a user photo thumbnail, nickname, usage-period tag and one highlighted sentence

X1.name: 컬러 스와치 매트릭스
X1.layout: grid of color chips (2-4 columns) with Korean and English names, optional selection-criteria header row; white background

X2.name: 사이즈 3중 제시
X2.layout: nested rectangle diagram of size options → photo of a person or a familiar object holding the product with dimension overlays → model-height caption; keep all measurements as given

X3.name: 선제 FAQ 카드(불량 오인 방지)
X3.layout: 3 stacked cards: left half a close-up comparison photo, right half a bold question line and a 3-5 line answer; reassurance head above the stack

X4.name: 다크 배너 섹션 전환
X4.layout: full-width dark band with one label-style headline and an optional one-line sub; used as a section divider before an add-on, care or spec block

X5.name: 숨 고르기 무카피 사진
X5.layout: single full-bleed lifestyle or texture photograph with no text; inserted between information blocks to reset attention

X6.name: STEP 라인아트 그리드
X6.layout: 3-6 numbered circle badges with simple line illustrations in a grid, arrows between steps, minimal text (one short line per step)

X7.name: 계산식 공개 표
X7.layout: comparison bar chart with our product at the far right and a circular badge on the smallest value, then a 3-row table condition / formula / result; footnote with measurement basis

X8.name: 구성품 캡션 그리드
X8.layout: 3-5 real photos of included items in a row or 2x2 grid, each with only a short name label beneath; no headline needed

X9.name: 고객 목소리 말풍선 오프너
X9.layout: 3-4 speech-bubble cards quoting customer complaints or requests (only from input), one headline about why the product was made or renewed; product absent or tiny

X10.name: 계단식 가격표(클로징 오퍼)
X10.layout: 3-column step table (early-bird / second round / regular) with only dates and prices from input, one line of scarcity that is true, CTA line; placed after trust modules, not at the top
